name: Financial Calculator
author: Mortgage Calculator

sections.description:
The Financial Calculator plugin gives your visitors a loan and finance calculator that shows indicative repayments instantly, without a page reload. Add an optional application form and they can send a finance enquiry to you straight from the same page. It suits car dealers, brokers, lenders and any site that offers loans or finance.

There are two calculators, each with its own shortcode: a finance calculator for vehicle-style finance (price, deposit, trade-in, rate) and a loan calculator that offers a list of loan types and rates that you define.

Features

  • Finance calculator: price, finance rate, deposit and trade-in allowance, with monthly payments shown for 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 and 72 months and the total cost of the credit
  • Loan calculator: choose a loan type, enter the loan amount and the repayment period in years, and see weekly, fortnightly and monthly payments, total repayment and total interest
  • Optional finance application form that is sent by email to the address you set
  • Settings page for the default finance rate, application email address, currency code and symbol, and the list of loan types and rates
  • Show or hide the application button
  • Shortcode attributes to override the rate or fix the price
  • Calculates in the browser, so results appear immediately

How to use

Add one of the shortcodes to a page or post:

[finance_calculator]

[loan_calculator]

Override the default rate for one calculator, or fix the price:

[finance_calculator rate="9.9" price="16000"]

Use digits only in the price (16000, not 16,000). Then open the Finance Calculator settings page in the admin area to set the default rate, application email, currency and, for the loan calculator, the loan options in the format name|percentage,name|percentage, for example Motor Loan|7.9,Standard Loan|9.

Use cases

  • Car finance and dealership websites
  • Loan brokers, lenders and credit unions
  • Personal, motor and other loan enquiry pages
  • Blogs and comparison sites that want an indicative repayment calculator

Please note

The figures are indicative only and are not a loan offer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to your plugins folder, usually wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin on the plugin screen.
  3. Configure the plugin.

Note: Upgrading from 1.x to 2.x will automatically deactivate the plugin. Head over to your Plugins section and reactivate it.
sections.faq:
How do I add the form to a post or page?

You need to add the [finance_calculator] or the [loan_calculator] shortcode to the body of the post/page.

Where are the application submissions sent?

They are sent by email (using WordPress’ wp_mail function) to the address you enter under Application Email on the plugin’s settings page. The applicant’s email address is used as the Reply-To address.

Are submissions stored in the WordPress database?

No. The plugin sends the application by email and does not save it in the database. Because the form collects personal details, make sure your site has a privacy notice and that you handle the emails you receive in line with the data protection rules that apply to you.

Can I change the interest rate and the loan types?

Yes. Set the default finance rate in the settings, or override it per page with the rate attribute, for example [finance_calculator rate="7.5"]. For the loan calculator, enter your own loan types and rates in the Loan Options box, in the format name|percentage,name|percentage.

Can I hide the application form?

Yes. In the settings choose “Hide finance application button”. The calculator then works on its own.

Is it suitable for car finance and personal loans?

Yes. The finance calculator is built around a price, deposit and trade-in allowance, which suits vehicle finance, and the loan calculator lets you define loan types such as motor or personal loans. Results are indicative repayments, not a loan offer.
